title: File Extension Categorizer
spec: Write a function `classify(files)` that takes a list of file extensions. Check each extension to determine its general category. If it is pdf or docx, classify it as document. If it is jpg or png, classify it as image. If it is mp4 or avi, classify it as video. If it is mp3 or wav, classify it as audio. If an extension is unknown, classify it as other. Return a list of the resulting classifications.

title: Task State Machine
spec: Write a function `transition(actions)` that starts a background job in the pending state. For each action in the given list, update the current state. If the action is start, change the state to running. If the action is pause, change to suspended. If the action is resume, change to running. If the action is fail, change to error. If the action is finish, change to complete. Return a list of the recorded states after every applied action.

title: Traffic Light Controller
spec: Write a function `simulate(events)` that controls an intersection traffic light starting at red. For each event in the list, update the light accordingly. If the event is timer, change red to green, green to yellow, and yellow to red. If the event is emergency, change any current state to red. If the event is maintenance, change the state to blinking. Return a list of all light states after each event is processed.

title: E-commerce Cart Analyzer
spec: Write a function `summarize(events)` that processes a list of shopping cart actions. Track a total item count starting at zero. If the action is add, increase the count. If the action is remove, decrease the count. If the action is clear, set the count to zero. If the action is checkout, return the word success. If the end of the list is reached without a checkout action, return the word abandoned.

title: Compass Navigation
spec: Write a function `navigate(directions)` that tracks a compass facing starting at north. For each command in the list, update the facing direction. If the command is turn right, change the facing from north to east, east to south, south to west, and west to north. If the command is turn left, change the facing from north to west, west to south, south to east, and east to north. Return the final facing direction after all commands.

title: Planet Classifier
spec: Write a function `categorize(planets)` that takes a list of solar system planet names. Return their planetary category based on basic astronomy. If the planet is mercury, venus, earth, or mars, the category is terrestrial. If the planet is jupiter or saturn, the category is gas giant. If the planet is uranus or neptune, the category is ice giant. If the planet is pluto, the category is dwarf planet. If the name is not recognized, the category is invalid. Return a list of the categories.

title: Chatbot Intent Parser
spec: Write a function `parse(messages)` that analyzes a list of user text inputs to find their underlying meaning. If a message starts with hello or hi, the intent is greeting. If it contains price or cost, the intent is billing. If it contains help or support, the intent is assistance. If it contains bye or quit, the intent is closing. Otherwise, the intent is unknown. Return a list of the determined intents.

title: Musical Note Translator
spec: Write a function `translate(notes)` that converts a list of solfege syllables to standard musical letters. If a note is do, translate it to c. If a note is re, translate it to d. If a note is mi, translate it to e. If a note is fa, translate it to f. If a note is sol, translate it to g. If a note is la, translate it to a. If a note is ti, translate it to b. Return a list of the translated letters.

title: Weather Forecast Simplifier
spec: Write a function `forecast(readings)` that translates a list of short weather condition codes into readable phrases for a display board. If the code is clr, output clear sky. If the code is cld, output cloudy. If the code is rn, output raining. If the code is sn, output snowing. If the code is st, output stormy. If the code is fg, output foggy. If the code is unk, output unknown weather. Return a list of the readable outputs.

title: Database SQL Generator
spec: Write a function `generate(operations)` that translates a list of simple database operation types into basic query prefixes. If the operation is read, produce select from table. If the operation is add, produce insert into table. If the operation is modify, produce update table set. If the operation is remove, produce delete from table. If the operation is count, produce select count from table. Return a list of the produced prefixes.

title: Animal Enclosure Router
spec: Write a function `route(animals)` that assigns a list of incoming animal types to specific zoo zones. If the animal is lion or tiger, assign it to big cats. If the animal is elephant or rhino, assign it to plains. If the animal is penguin or seal, assign it to aquatic. If the animal is monkey or ape, assign it to primates. If the animal is parrot or eagle, assign it to aviary. Return a list of the assigned zones.

title: Subscription Tier Features
spec: Write a function `features(tiers)` that returns the primary benefit for a list of subscription levels. If the tier is free, the benefit is basic access. If the tier is bronze, the benefit is ad removal. If the tier is silver, the benefit is high definition. If the tier is gold, the benefit is offline downloads. If the tier is platinum, the benefit is family sharing. If the tier is diamond, the benefit is dedicated support. Return a list of the benefits.

title: CSS Theme Color Resolver
spec: Write a function `resolve(statuses)` that maps a list of user interface states to visual theme colors. If the status is success, the color is green. If the status is error, the color is red. If the status is warning, the color is yellow. If the status is info, the color is blue. If the status is disabled, the color is gray. If the status is active, the color is purple. Return a list of the resolved colors.

title: Notification Delivery Method
spec: Write a function `dispatch(alerts)` that determines how to send system alerts based on a list of priority levels. If a priority is critical, the method is phone call. If the priority is high, the method is sms text. If the priority is medium, the method is email. If the priority is low, the method is push notification. If the priority is none, the method is console log. Return a list of the required delivery methods.

title: Keyboard Shortcut Binder
spec: Write a function `bind(keys)` that maps a list of single key presses to text editor commands. If the key is c, the command is copy. If the key is v, the command is paste. If the key is x, the command is cut. If the key is z, the command is undo. If the key is y, the command is redo. If the key is s, the command is save. Return a list of the corresponding commands.

title: Order Fulfillment Steps
spec: Write a function `process(orders)` that determines the next manufacturing step for a list of current order phases. If the current phase is new, the next step is assembly. If the phase is assembly, the next step is painting. If the phase is painting, the next step is testing. If the phase is testing, the next step is packaging. If the phase is packaging, the next step is shipping. Return a list of the upcoming steps.

title: Character Class Attributes
spec: Write a function `attributes(classes)` that returns the primary statistic for a list of roleplaying game character roles. If the role is warrior, the statistic is strength. If the role is mage, the statistic is intelligence. If the role is rogue, the statistic is dexterity. If the role is cleric, the statistic is wisdom. If the role is bard, the statistic is charisma. If the role is paladin, the statistic is vitality. Return a list of the statistics.

title: Chess Piece Movement Types
spec: Write a function `describe(pieces)` that describes the basic movement pattern for a list of chess units. If the unit is pawn, it moves forward. If the unit is rook, it moves straight. If the unit is bishop, it moves diagonally. If the unit is knight, it moves in an l shape. If the unit is queen, it moves in all directions. If the unit is king, it moves one square. Return a list of the descriptions.

title: Appliance Energy Modes
spec: Write a function `manage(modes)` that sets the power output profile based on a list of selected appliance settings. If the setting is eco, the output is low. If the setting is normal, the output is medium. If the setting is boost, the output is high. If the setting is clean, the output is maximum. If the setting is standby, the output is resting. If the setting is off, the output is zero. Return a list of the power outputs.

title: Month to Season Converter
spec: Write a function `convert(months)` that maps a list of month names to their primary meteorological season in the northern hemisphere. If the month is march, april, or may, the season is spring. If the month is june, july, or august, the season is summer. If the month is september, october, or november, the season is autumn. If the month is december, january, or february, the season is winter. Return a list of the translated seasons.

title: File System Permissions
spec: Write a function `evaluate(codes)` that translates a list of single letter file system permission flags into their full readable words. If the flag is r, the word is read. If the flag is w, the word is write. If the flag is x, the word is execute. If the flag is d, the word is delete. If the flag is o, the word is owner. If the flag is a, the word is all. Return a list of the full words.

title: Vehicle Toll Calculator
spec: Write a function `assess(vehicles)` that determines the toll description for a list of vehicle types crossing a toll bridge. If the vehicle is motorcycle, the toll is half price. If the vehicle is sedan, the toll is standard price. If the vehicle is suv, the toll is standard plus. If the vehicle is truck, the toll is heavy duty. If the vehicle is bus, the toll is commercial rate. If the vehicle is bicycle, the toll is free. Return a list of the toll descriptions.

title: Beverage Categorizer
spec: Write a function `classify(drinks)` that determines the menu category for a list of common beverages. If the drink is espresso or latte, the category is coffee. If the drink is matcha or chamomile, the category is tea. If the drink is cola or ginger ale, the category is soda. If the drink is apple or orange, the category is juice. If the drink is unrecognized, the category is unknown. Return a list of the categories.

title: Botanical Tree Groups
spec: Write a function `identify(trees)` that assigns a botanical group to a list of everyday tree names. If the tree is pine or fir, the group is conifer. If the tree is oak or maple, the group is broadleaf. If the tree is palm or bamboo, the group is tropical. If the tree is apple or cherry, the group is fruit bearing. If the tree is not on the list, the group is unclassified. Return a list of the assigned botanical groups.

title: Chore Department Router
spec: Write a function `schedule(tasks)` that assigns a maintenance department to a list of household chores. If the chore is sweeping or mopping, the department is cleaning. If the chore is cooking or baking, the department is kitchen. If the chore is painting or fixing, the department is maintenance. If the chore is guarding or patrolling, the department is security. Return a list of the assigned departments in the order they were provided.

title: Log Severity Filter
spec: Takes an array of arrays where each inner array has a severity level and a message. Evaluate the severity using the `filter(logs)` function. Keep only logs with severity error, fatal, or critical. Discard debug, info, and warning. Return an array of the kept messages, appending the severity name in uppercase in parentheses to the end of each message. For example, given an inner array of error and database crash, it should return an array containing database crash (ERROR).

title: Drink Size Cost
spec: Calculates the total price of a coffee order using the `calculate(orders)` function, which receives an array of requested cup sizes. A short costs two dollars, a tall costs three, a grande costs four, a venti costs five, and a trenta costs six. If an unknown size like mug or demi is encountered, ignore it. Apply a discount of one dollar if the array contains more than four items. Return a sentence stating the total cost, formatted exactly as Total is followed by the numerical value.

title: Camera Mode Selector
spec: Takes an array of scene descriptions to photograph. Determine the best camera configuration using the `shoot(scenes)` function. Map sports and action to shutter priority. Map portraits and macro to aperture priority. Map landscapes and architecture to manual mode. Map parties and indoors to auto flash. Any other scene should default to program auto. Return an array of the selected camera modes. For example, given an array with sports and portraits, return an array with shutter priority and aperture priority.

title: Astrological Sign Calculator
spec: Converts an array of birth months into their primary astrological sign using the `zodiac(months)` function. Use a simplified rule where the whole month corresponds to one sign. Use aries for april, taurus for may, gemini for june, cancer for july, leo for august, virgo for september, libra for october, scorpio for november, sagittarius for december, capricorn for january, aquarius for february, and pisces for march. Return an array of these signs. Unknown inputs should become unknown.

title: Server Error Describer
spec: Translates an array of text based network status messages into descriptions using the `describe(codes)` function. Map the string ok to success, the string bad request to user error, the string unauthorized to login required, the string forbidden to access denied, the string not found to missing page, and the string internal error to server crash. Map anything else to unknown status. Return an array of these text descriptions. Example: given an array containing ok and forbidden, return an array with success and access denied.

title: Creature Diet Grouping
spec: Takes an array of animal names and returns their diet category via the `classify(animals)` function. Map lion, tiger, and wolf to carnivore. Map cow, sheep, and deer to herbivore. Map bear, pig, and human to omnivore. Map vulture and hyena to scavenger. Any other animal becomes unclassified. Return an array of the diet types corresponding to each input in the exact same order.

title: Simple Tag Verifier
spec: Evaluates an array of opening and closing tags using the `verify(tags)` function. Valid opening tags are div, span, paragraph, and anchor. Valid closing tags are enddiv, endspan, endparagraph, and endanchor. Use a stack to check if the tags are perfectly balanced. If perfectly balanced, return the word valid. If a tag is closed out of order, return the word mismatch. If tags remain open at the end, return the word incomplete.

title: Shape Sorter
spec: Groups an array of geometric forms using the `sort(shapes)` function. Group them into three arrays: polygons, curves, and others. Map triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon, and octagon to polygons. Map circle, oval, ellipse, and crescent to curves. Put anything else in others. Return an array containing the three group arrays in the exact order of polygons, curves, and others.

title: Letter Grade Points
spec: Converts an array of letter grades into a numerical average via the `gpa(grades)` function. Excellent is worth four points, good is worth three, average is worth two, poor is worth one, and failing is worth zero. Also recognize withdraw, audit, and incomplete, which contribute no points and do not count towards the total number of classes. Return a sentence formatted as Average is followed by the calculated number.

title: Hand Game Referee
spec: Takes an array of arrays, where each inner array contains two strings representing player one and player two moves. Determine the outcome using the `judge(matches)` function. The valid moves are rock, paper, scissors, lizard, and spock. Determine the winner for each match according to standard extended rules. Return an array containing the word player one, player two, or draw for each match. If an invalid move is found, output invalid for that specific match.

title: Primary Color Mixer
spec: Takes an array of arrays, where each pair represents two primary colors being mixed. Find the result using the `mix(colors)` function. The standard valid inputs are red, blue, and yellow. Determine the resulting secondary color: purple, green, or orange. If white is mixed with any valid color, return the word light. If black is mixed with any valid color, return the word dark. If the same color is mixed with itself, return that exact color. If an invalid color is present, return the word error. Return an array of the resulting mixed colors.

title: Board Material Counter
spec: Takes an array of chess piece names and calculates the total material value using the `evaluate(pieces)` function. Map pawn to one, knight to three, bishop to three, rook to five, and queen to nine. Treat king as zero. If the array includes the word capture, multiply the final total by two. If it includes the word sacrifice, divide the final total by two. Return the numerical score. For example, given pawn, rook, and capture, the score is twelve.

title: Snack Machine Dispenser
spec: Takes an array of button codes pressed on a snack machine and processes them with the `vend(codes)` function. Map the code alpha one to chips, alpha two to pretzels, beta one to cola, beta two to water, gamma one to cookies, and gamma two to gum. If a code is the word empty, return the word please select. For any unknown code, return the word refund. Return an array of dispensed items or messages in the order requested.

title: Weekday Weekend Sorter
spec: Takes an array of day names and categorizes them using the `schedule(days)` function. Group them into three categories: weekday, weekend, and invalid. Monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, and friday are weekdays. Saturday and sunday are weekends. Anything else is invalid. Return an array containing three nested arrays in the order of weekdays, weekends, and invalids, populated with the original input strings.

title: Audio Track Categorizer
spec: Takes an array of musical style names and groups them into overarching genres using the `categorize(tracks)` function. Map rock, metal, and punk to heavy. Map jazz, blues, and soul to smooth. Map techno, house, and trance to electronic. Map rap and hiphop to urban. Any other style maps to miscellaneous. Return an array of the overarching genres corresponding to each input. For example, given metal and jazz, return an array with heavy and smooth.

title: Loose Change Counter
spec: Takes an array of coin names and sums up their total value in cents using the `tally(coins)` function. A penny is one, a nickel is five, a dime is ten, a quarter is twenty five, a half dollar is fifty, and a dollar coin is one hundred. Treat the word foreign as zero but subtract five cents from the total as a penalty. Ignore unknown strings entirely. Return a sentence formatting the total, formatted exactly as Total cents is followed by the calculated number.

title: Garment Size Abbreviator
spec: Takes an array of full clothing size words and shrinks them using the `abbreviate(sizes)` function. Convert extra small to the letters xs, small to s, medium to m, large to l, extra large to xl, and double extra large to xxl. If a size is already an abbreviation, leave it completely unchanged. If the size is unknown, replace it with the word custom. Return the new array of converted sizes.

title: Metro Line Stops
spec: Takes an array of train station names and determines which metro line they belong to using the `route(stations)` function. Map downtown and central to the red line. Map uptown and north station to the blue line. Map west end and east side to the green line. Map airport and harbor to the silver line. If a station is not recognized, output bus transfer. Return an array of the corresponding line names for each station.

title: Flatpack Instructions
spec: Takes an array of part names to assemble and generates steps via the `assemble(parts)` function. For each part, output the corresponding action. For screws, output grab screwdriver. For pegs, output grab hammer. For boards, output apply glue. For hinges, output attach door. For handles, output tighten bolt. For anything else, output check manual. Return an array of the action instructions. Example: given pegs and boards, return grab hammer and apply glue.

title: Basic Greeting Translator
spec: Translates an array of english greetings into their spanish equivalents using the `translate(greetings)` function. Map hello to hola, goodbye to adios, please to por favor, thanks to gracias, yes to si, and no to no. If the word morning is present, output buenos dias. For night, output buenas noches. Any unrecognized word should be replaced with a single question mark. Return the fully translated array.

title: Pepper Heat Scale
spec: Takes an array of pepper types and determines their heat category using the `heat(peppers)` function. Map bell and banana to mild. Map poblano and jalapeno to medium. Map habanero and scotch bonnet to hot. Map ghost and reaper to extreme. Any other pepper should be labeled as warning. Return an array of the heat categories in the exact same sequence as the provided input.

title: Waste Management Sorter
spec: Takes an array of trash item materials and groups them into proper disposal bins using the `sort(items)` function. Map cardboard, newspaper, and magazine to paper bin. Map bottle, jug, and jar to plastic bin. Map can, foil, and tin to metal bin. Map apple, peel, and core to compost bin. Anything else goes to the landfill bin. Return an array of the bin destinations corresponding to the items.

title: Sentiment Keyword Matcher
spec: Evaluates an array of words to determine the overall mood via the `analyze(words)` function. Count the occurrences of positive words like happy, great, excellent, and joyful. Count the negative words like sad, terrible, awful, and miserable. Ignore neutral words like okay, fine, and whatever. If positive exceeds negative, return the word optimistic. If negative exceeds positive, return the word pessimistic. If they are exactly equal, return the word balanced.

title: Tournament Podium Points
spec: Calculates team points from an array of placement finishes using the `score(results)` function. A gold finish awards five points. A silver finish awards three points. A bronze finish awards one point. A wildcard finish awards two points. A disqualified finish subtracts two points. A forfeit finish subtracts five points. A participation finish awards zero points. Add up the total points and return a sentence stating Score is followed by the total.

title: Machine Health Checker
spec: Takes an array of sensor status codes from factory equipment and translates them via the `monitor(readings)` function. Map nominal and stable to healthy. Map fluctuating and vibrating to inspection needed. Map overheating and sparking to immediate shutdown. Map disconnected to offline. If an empty string is provided, output no data. Return an array of the corresponding action recommendations. Example: given nominal and sparking, return healthy and immediate shutdown.

title: Book Genre Categorizer
spec: Write a function `categorize(books)` that takes a list of objects. Each object has a subject property. The function should return a list of strings representing the genre of each book. If the subject is magic or dragons, the genre is fantasy. If the subject is spaceships or aliens, the genre is sci-fi. If the subject is murder or detective, the genre is mystery. If the subject is ghosts or vampires, the genre is horror. For any other subject, the genre is fiction. Example input: a list with an object having subject aliens. Example output: a list containing sci-fi.

title: Coffee Order Customizer
spec: Write a function `customize(orders)` that processes a list of order objects. Each object has a base and a syrup property. Return a list of strings describing the final drink. If the base is espresso and syrup is vanilla, the string is vanilla espresso. If the base is cold brew and syrup is caramel, the string is sweet cold brew. If the base is matcha and syrup is none, the string is plain green tea latte. If the base is drip and syrup is hazelnut, the string is nutty drip coffee. If the base is espresso and syrup is none, the string is black espresso. For all other combinations, return standard coffee. Example input: base cold brew and syrup caramel. Example output: a list containing sweet cold brew.

title: Ticket Priority Assigner
spec: Write a function `prioritize(tickets)` that takes a list of support ticket objects. Each ticket has a severity and a customer property. Return a list of string priorities. If severity is critical and customer is enterprise, return urgent. If severity is high and customer is enterprise, return high. If severity is critical and customer is standard, return high. If severity is low and customer is standard, return low. If severity is medium, return normal. For all other combinations, return normal. Example input: severity critical and customer enterprise. Example output: a list containing urgent.

title: Social Media Action Formatter
spec: Write a function `format(actions)` that takes a list of action objects. Each object has a type and a context property. Return a list of description strings. If the type is like and context is post, return user liked a post. If the type is share and context is image, return user shared an image. If the type is comment and context is video, return user commented on a video. If the type is follow and context is profile, return user followed a new profile. If the type is block and context is profile, return user blocked a profile. For any other combination, return user performed an action. Example input: type share and context image. Example output: a list containing user shared an image.

title: Recipe Step Generator
spec: Write a function `generate(ingredients)` that takes a list of ingredient objects. Each object has a category and a preparation property. Return a list of instruction strings. If category is vegetable and preparation is chop, return carefully chop the vegetables. If category is vegetable and preparation is slice, return thinly slice the vegetables. If category is meat and preparation is dice, return cut the meat into small cubes. If category is meat and preparation is mince, return finely mince the meat. If category is fruit and preparation is peel, return remove the skin from the fruit. For any other combination, return prepare ingredients as desired. Example input: category vegetable and preparation chop. Example output: a list containing carefully chop the vegetables.

title: Device Status Normalizer
spec: Write a function `normalize(devices)` that takes a list of device objects. Each object has a state and a battery property. Return a list of normalized status strings. If state is active and battery is full, return running smoothly. If state is active and battery is low, return running but needs charge. If state is sleep and battery is low, return waking up to charge. If state is sleep and battery is full, return resting. If state is offline, return disconnected. For anything else, return unknown state. Example input: state active and battery full. Example output: a list containing running smoothly.

title: Plant Watering Schedule
spec: Write a function `schedule(plants)` that takes a list of plant objects. Each object has a species and a soil property. Return a list of watering instruction strings. If species is cactus and soil is dry, return do not water. If species is fern and soil is dry, return water heavily. If species is fern and soil is moist, return mist leaves. If species is orchid and soil is dry, return soak roots. If species is orchid and soil is moist, return leave alone. For any other species, return water normally. Example input: species fern and soil dry. Example output: a list containing water heavily.

title: Furniture Assembly Helper
spec: Write a function `assemble(parts)` that takes a list of part objects. Each object has a component and a fastener property. Return a list of assembly step strings. If component is leg and fastener is screw, return attach leg with screws. If component is shelf and fastener is peg, return rest shelf on pegs. If component is door and fastener is hinge, return mount door on hinges. If component is backboard and fastener is nail, return nail backboard in place. If component is drawer and fastener is slider, return insert drawer into sliders. Example input: component leg and fastener screw. Example output: a list containing attach leg with screws.

title: Gym Workout Planner
spec: Write a function `plan(exercises)` that takes a list of exercise objects. Each object has a movement and a level property. Return a list of workout routine strings. If movement is pushup and level is beginner, return do knee pushups. If movement is pushup and level is advanced, return do clapping pushups. If movement is squat and level is beginner, return do bodyweight squats. If movement is squat and level is advanced, return do jump squats. If movement is plank and level is beginner, return hold short plank. Otherwise, return do standard movement. Example input: movement pushup and level beginner. Example output: a list containing do knee pushups.

title: Event Venue Recommender
spec: Write a function `recommend(events)` that takes a list of event objects. Each object has a size and a season property. Return a list of string venue recommendations. If size is large and season is summer, return outdoor stadium. If size is large and season is winter, return indoor arena. If size is small and season is summer, return garden pavilion. If size is small and season is winter, return cozy hall. If size is medium and season is spring, return open tent. For anything else, return community center. Example input: size large and season summer. Example output: a list containing outdoor stadium.

title: Flight Status Announcer
spec: Write a function `announce(flights)` that takes a list of flight objects. Each object has a status and a timing property. Return a list of announcement strings. If status is boarding and timing is on time, return please proceed to gate. If status is boarding and timing is delayed, return boarding delayed slightly. If status is departed, return flight has left. If status is cancelled, return please visit customer service. If status is landed, return welcome to your destination. For any other status, return please check monitors. Example input: status boarding and timing on time. Example output: a list containing please proceed to gate.

title: Public Transit Fare Calculator
spec: Write a function `calculate(trips)` that takes a list of trip objects. Each object has a rider and a zone property. Return a list of string fare descriptions. If rider is senior and zone is local, return free ride. If rider is senior and zone is express, return discounted express. If rider is student and zone is local, return student local. If rider is student and zone is express, return student express. If rider is adult and zone is local, return standard local. If rider is adult and zone is express, return standard express. Example input: rider senior and zone local. Example output: a list containing free ride.

title: Emergency Response Dispatcher
spec: Write a function `dispatch(incidents)` that takes a list of incident objects. Each object has a category and a hazard property. Return a list of dispatch instruction strings. If category is fire and hazard is chemical, return dispatch hazmat team. If category is fire and hazard is none, return dispatch fire engine. If category is medical and hazard is severe, return dispatch paramedic unit. If category is medical and hazard is none, return dispatch basic ambulance. If category is rescue and hazard is water, return dispatch dive team. Otherwise, return dispatch standard patrol. Example input: category fire and hazard chemical. Example output: a list containing dispatch hazmat team.

title: Hotel Room Amenity Finder
spec: Write a function `find(rooms)` that takes a list of room objects. Each object has a view and a tier property. Return a list of amenity strings. If view is ocean and tier is suite, return champagne and balcony access. If view is ocean and tier is standard, return beach towels. If view is city and tier is suite, return minibar and skyline lounge. If view is city and tier is standard, return earplugs. If view is garden and tier is suite, return fresh flowers. For all others, return complimentary water. Example input: view ocean and tier suite. Example output: a list containing champagne and balcony access.

title: Software Update Classifier
spec: Write a function `classify(updates)` that takes a list of update objects. Each object has a type property and an impact property. Return a list of string classifications. If type is security and impact is high, return critical major update. If type is security and impact is low, return critical patch. If type is feature and impact is high, return major release. If type is feature and impact is low, return minor release. If type is bugfix, return patch release. For any other combination, return unclassified update. Example input: type security and impact high. Example output: a list containing critical major update.

title: Movie Rating Explainer
spec: Write a function `explain(movies)` that takes a list of movie objects. Each object has an audience and a violence property. Return a list of string explanations. If audience is children and violence is none, return suitable for all ages. If audience is children and violence is mild, return parental guidance suggested. If audience is teens and violence is mild, return appropriate for teens. If audience is teens and violence is high, return restricted for teens. If audience is adults, return adults only. Otherwise, return unrated. Example input: audience children and violence none. Example output: a list containing suitable for all ages.

title: Package Delivery Tracker
spec: Write a function `track(packages)` that takes a list of package objects. Each object has a location and a requirement property. Return a list of tracking status strings. If location is warehouse, return awaiting sorting. If location is transit, return on the move. If location is facility, return at local facility. If location is destination and requirement is mandatory, return out for delivery signature needed. If location is destination and requirement is none, return out for delivery dropoff. Otherwise, return tracking unavailable. Example input: location warehouse. Example output: a list containing awaiting sorting.

title: Custom T-Shirt Pricing
spec: Write a function `price(shirts)` that takes a list of shirt objects. Each object has a color and a print property. Return a list of string price codes. If color is white and print is basic, return budget tier. If color is white and print is full, return standard tier. If color is black and print is basic, return standard tier. If color is black and print is full, return premium tier. If color is neon and print is basic, return premium tier. If color is neon and print is full, return luxury tier. Example input: color white and print basic. Example output: a list containing budget tier.

title: Bakery Item Shelf Life
spec: Write a function `evaluate(items)` that takes a list of bakery item objects. Each object has a dough and a filling property. Return a list of shelf life strings. If dough is pastry and filling is cream, return refrigerate consume today. If dough is pastry and filling is fruit, return room temperature consume today. If dough is bread and filling is none, return room temperature good for three days. If dough is bread and filling is cheese, return refrigerate good for two days. If dough is cookie, return room temperature good for one week. Otherwise, return ask baker. Example input: dough pastry and filling cream. Example output: a list containing refrigerate consume today.

title: Job Application Status
spec: Write a function `process(applications)` that takes a list of application objects. Each object has a stage and a decision property. Return a list of applicant notification strings. If stage is resume and decision is pass, return invite to phone screen. If stage is resume and decision is reject, return send standard rejection. If stage is interview and decision is pass, return invite to final round. If stage is interview and decision is reject, return send personalized rejection. If stage is offer and decision is pass, return send offer letter. Otherwise, return application under review. Example input: stage resume and decision pass. Example output: a list containing invite to phone screen.

title: Customer Loyalty Rewards
spec: Write a function `reward(customers)` that takes a list of customer objects. Each customer has a status and a volume property. Return a list of string rewards. If status is platinum and volume is high, return free international flight. If status is platinum and volume is low, return free domestic flight. If status is gold and volume is high, return free hotel stay. If status is gold and volume is low, return free lounge access. If status is silver and volume is high, return free checked bag. For all others, return no current reward. Example input: status platinum and volume high. Example output: a list containing free international flight.

title: Pet Care Instructions
spec: Write a function `instruct(pets)` that takes a list of pet objects. Each object has an animal and a coat property. Return a list of care instruction strings. If animal is dog and coat is long, return brush daily and bathe monthly. If animal is dog and coat is short, return brush weekly and bathe occasionally. If animal is cat and coat is long, return brush daily to prevent mats. If animal is cat and coat is short, return brush weekly. If animal is bird, return clean cage daily. For any other animal, return provide basic care. Example input: animal dog and coat long. Example output: a list containing brush daily and bathe monthly.

title: Appliance Repair Estimator
spec: Write a function `estimate(appliances)` that takes a list of appliance objects. Each object has a type and an issue property. Return a list of string repair estimates. If type is refrigerator and issue is cooling, return compressor repair needed. If type is refrigerator and issue is leaking, return seal replacement needed. If type is washer and issue is draining, return pump repair needed. If type is washer and issue is spinning, return belt replacement needed. If type is oven and issue is heating, return element repair needed. Otherwise, return full diagnostic needed. Example input: type refrigerator and issue cooling. Example output: a list containing compressor repair needed.

title: Grocery Aisle Locator
spec: Write a function `locate(items)` that takes a list of grocery item objects. Each object has a category and a storage property. Return a list of aisle location strings. If category is dairy and storage is cold, return aisle four refrigerated. If category is produce and storage is cold, return front of store misting display. If category is produce and storage is ambient, return front of store bins. If category is meat and storage is frozen, return aisle five frozen. If category is bakery and storage is ambient, return aisle one fresh. Otherwise, return ask store associate. Example input: category dairy and storage cold. Example output: a list containing aisle four refrigerated.

title: Holiday Gift Recommender
spec: Write a function `suggest(profiles)` that takes a list of person objects. Each object has an age and an interest property. Return a list of string gift suggestions. If age is child and interest is reading, return illustrated storybook. If age is child and interest is sports, return soccer ball. If age is teen and interest is reading, return fantasy novel series. If age is teen and interest is sports, return team jersey. If age is adult and interest is reading, return e-reader device. For any other combination, return gift card. Example input: age child and interest reading. Example output: a list containing illustrated storybook.

title: Instrument Family Classifier
spec: Implement a function `classify(instruments)` that receives a list of instrument names and maps each to its orchestral family. Flute, clarinet, and oboe map to woodwind. Trumpet, trombone, and tuba map to brass. Violin, cello, and harp map to string. Snare, timpani, and cymbal map to percussion. Any other instrument maps to unknown. Return a list of the corresponding family names. Include a brief driver block that tests the function with various inputs. Example: ["flute", "tuba", "kazoo"] returns ["woodwind", "brass", "unknown"].

title: Coffee Machine Error Translator
spec: Create a function `translate(codes)` that processes a list of numeric error codes from a coffee machine and returns a list of human readable messages. Code ten means add water. Code twenty means empty grounds. Code thirty means clean filter. Code forty means descale needed. Code fifty means bean hopper empty. Code sixty means drip tray full. Code seventy means brew group error. Any other number means contact service. Write a small main section to process a sample list of codes. Example: [20, 40, 99] returns ["empty grounds", "descale needed", "contact service"].

title: Bridge Type Selector
spec: Write a function `bridge(spans)` that takes a list of gap descriptions and assigns each to the most suitable bridge architecture. A short ditch uses a simple culvert. A small creek uses a beam bridge. A local river uses an arch bridge. A wide highway uses a truss bridge. A deep gorge uses a cantilever bridge. A large bay uses a cable stayed bridge. A major ocean strait uses a suspension bridge. A temporary crossing uses a floating pontoon. Anything else uses a custom viaduct. Return a list of the bridge types. Add a driver section that runs the function on a list of gap descriptions. Example: ["small creek", "large bay", "mud puddle"] returns ["beam bridge", "cable stayed bridge", "custom viaduct"].

title: Chess Opening Names
spec: Design a function `identify(openings)` that accepts a list of first move pairs and returns their traditional chess opening names. Pawn to e4 and e5 is the open game. Pawn to d4 and d5 is the closed game. Pawn to e4 and c5 is the sicilian defense. Pawn to e4 and e6 is the french defense. Pawn to d4 and Nf6 is the indian defense. Pawn to e4 and c6 is the caro kann. Pawn to f4 and d5 is the bird opening. Any other combination is standard play. Return a list of opening names. Provide a short test driver. Example: ["e4 e5", "d4 Nf6", "a3 a6"] returns ["open game", "indian defense", "standard play"].

title: Tea Steeping Times
spec: Implement a function `steep(teas)` that takes a list of tea types and returns their recommended steeping instructions. White tea needs two minutes at eighty degrees. Green tea needs three minutes at eighty degrees. Oolong tea needs four minutes at ninety degrees. Black tea needs five minutes at boiling. Herbal tea needs seven minutes at boiling. Rooibos tea needs six minutes at boiling. Matcha needs whisking not steeping. Any other tea should return consult packaging. Output the list of instructions and include a driver block to demonstrate usage. Example: ["green tea", "matcha", "chai"] returns ["three minutes at eighty degrees", "whisking not steeping", "consult packaging"].

title: Ski Trail Difficulty
spec: Create a function `rate(trails)` that processes a list of ski trail markers and returns their difficulty levels. Green circle is beginner. Blue square is intermediate. Black diamond is advanced. Double black diamond is expert. Orange oval is freestyle terrain. Red triangle is ski patrol only. Yellow triangle is slow skiing area. For any unrecognized marker, return off piste. Return a list of the difficulty ratings. Write a short main section to evaluate a sample list of trail markers. Example: ["blue square", "orange oval", "purple star"] returns ["intermediate", "freestyle terrain", "off piste"].

title: Battery Size Uses
spec: Write a function `usage(batteries)` that accepts a list of battery sizes and returns a list of their typical uses. Double a is for tv remotes. Triple a is for small toys. C size is for medium flashlights. D size is for large radios. Nine volt is for smoke alarms. Cr twenty thirty two is for watches. Lr forty four is for laser pointers. Unrecognized sizes should return specialized electronics. Include a small driver routine to map a handful of battery sizes. Example: ["double a", "nine volt", "a23"] returns ["tv remotes", "smoke alarms", "specialized electronics"].

title: Ship Type Roles
spec: Design a function `role(ships)` that takes a list of naval ship classifications and returns a list of their primary roles. Aircraft carrier is fleet air support. Destroyer is anti submarine warfare. Cruiser is multi role combat. Frigate is escort duties. Submarine is stealth operations. Minesweeper is hazard clearance. Patrol boat is coastal defense. Amphibious assault is troop transport. Anything else is auxiliary support. Provide a test driver that processes a fleet of mixed ship types. Example: ["frigate", "submarine", "tugboat"] returns ["escort duties", "stealth operations", "auxiliary support"].

title: Animal Collective Nouns
spec: Implement a function `group(animals)` that receives a list of animal names and maps each to its corresponding collective noun. Lion becomes pride. Crow becomes murder. Owl becomes parliament. Fish becomes school. Wolf becomes pack. Bee becomes swarm. Ant becomes colony. Sheep becomes flock. Cow becomes herd. Elephant becomes parade. Rhino becomes crash. Unrecognized animals should return simply group. Return a list of the collective nouns. Add a brief driver section to process an assortment of animals. Example: ["crow", "bee", "dog"] returns ["murder", "swarm", "group"].

title: Martial Arts Belts
spec: Create a function `rank(months)` that accepts a list of training durations in months and returns the expected martial arts belt color. Zero to two months is white belt. Three to five months is yellow belt. Six to eight months is orange belt. Nine to eleven months is green belt. Twelve to fourteen months is blue belt. Fifteen to seventeen months is purple belt. Eighteen to twenty months is brown belt. Twenty one to twenty three months is red belt. Twenty four or more months is black belt. Any invalid negative duration returns disqualified. Write a small main section to evaluate a sequence of student durations. Example: [1, 13, -5] returns ["white belt", "blue belt", "disqualified"].

title: Pasta Shape Pairings
spec: Write a function `pair(pastas)` that processes a list of pasta shapes and returns the best matching sauce for each. Spaghetti pairs with tomato basil. Fettuccine pairs with alfredo cream. Penne pairs with spicy arrabbiata. Rigatoni pairs with hearty meat ragu. Fusilli pairs with basil pesto. Macaroni pairs with melted cheddar. Farfalle pairs with light primavera. Linguine pairs with white clam sauce. Any other shape should return garlic and oil. Output the list of sauces and include a short driver to test a sample menu. Example: ["penne", "farfalle", "ziti"] returns ["spicy arrabbiata", "light primavera", "garlic and oil"].

title: Book Binding Types
spec: Design a function `describe(bindings)` that takes a list of book binding styles and returns a list of their physical descriptions. Hardcover is durable board covers. Paperback is thick paper covers. Mass market is small cheap paper. Spiral bound is looped wire spine. Saddle stitch is folded and stapled. Perfect bound is flat glued spine. Leather bound is premium hide cover. Board book is thick cardboard pages. For any other binding, return standard print. Include a brief test driver for a handful of bindings. Example: ["paperback", "saddle stitch", "ring bound"] returns ["thick paper covers", "folded and stapled", "standard print"].

title: Fire Extinguisher Classes
spec: Implement a function `extinguish(materials)` that receives a list of burning materials and maps each to the required fire extinguisher class. Wood or paper needs class a water. Flammable liquids or gasoline needs class b foam. Electrical fires or wiring needs class c carbon dioxide. Combustible metals or magnesium needs class d dry powder. Cooking oils or deep fryers needs class k wet chemical. For anything else, return evacuate immediately. Return a list of the extinguisher classes. Add a driver section that evaluates a set of fire hazards. Example: ["gasoline", "wiring", "plastic"] returns ["class b foam", "class c carbon dioxide", "evacuate immediately"].

title: Coin Mint Marks
spec: Create a function `locate(marks)` that accepts a list of coin mint mark letters and returns the city where they were struck. The letter p is philadelphia. The letter d is denver. The letter s is san francisco. The letter w is west point. The letter o is new orleans. The letter cc is carson city. The letter c is charlotte. If the mark is blank, return philadelphia standard. If unrecognized, return counterfeit or foreign. Output the list of cities and write a small main routine to locate a batch of coins. Example: ["d", "w", "x"] returns ["denver", "west point", "counterfeit or foreign"].

title: Paint Finishes
spec: Write a function `finish(rooms)` that processes a list of room types and returns the recommended paint finish for each. Bathroom requires semi gloss. Kitchen requires satin finish. Living room requires eggshell finish. Bedroom requires flat matte. Hallway requires durable eggshell. Ceiling requires ultra flat. Trim requires high gloss. Exterior requires weather resistant latex. Any other room type should return standard acrylic. Return the list of finishes. Include a short driver to plan painting for a house. Example: ["kitchen", "bedroom", "basement"] returns ["satin finish", "flat matte", "standard acrylic"].

title: Guitar Tuning Notes
spec: Design a function `tuning(strings)` that takes a list of string numbers (one through six) and returns the standard guitar tuning note for each. String one is high e. String two is b. String three is g. String four is d. String five is a. String six is low e. If a seven string guitar is used, string seven is low b. If an eight string guitar is used, string eight is low f sharp. If the string number does not match these, return string breaks. Output the list of notes. Provide a brief test driver that checks the notes for several different string numbers. Example: [1, 5, 9] returns ["high e", "a", "string breaks"].

title: Shoe Types by Activity
spec: Implement a function `footwear(activities)` that receives a list of physical activities and maps each to the recommended shoe type. Running needs cushioned sneakers. Hiking needs ankle support boots. Weightlifting needs flat rigid shoes. Soccer needs spiked cleats. Tennis needs lateral support court shoes. Swimming needs waterproof sandals. Ballet needs soft pointe shoes. Snowboarding needs stiff thermal boots. Unrecognized activities should return casual trainers. Return a list of the shoe types. Add a driver section that outfits a multi sport athlete. Example: ["hiking", "soccer", "walking"] returns ["ankle support boots", "spiked cleats", "casual trainers"].

title: Mattress Dimensions
spec: Create a function `dimensions(sizes)` that accepts a list of standard mattress names and returns a list of their dimensions. Crib is twenty eight by fifty two. Twin is thirty eight by seventy five. Twin xl is thirty eight by eighty. Full is fifty three by seventy five. Queen is sixty by eighty. King is seventy six by eighty. California king is seventy two by eighty four. Olympic queen is sixty six by eighty. Any other size name should return custom dimensions. Write a small main section to process a sample list of bed sizes. Example: ["twin", "queen", "rv bunk"] returns ["thirty eight by seventy five", "sixty by eighty", "custom dimensions"].

title: Bicycle Types
spec: Write a function `bicycle(terrains)` that processes a list of riding terrains and returns the best bicycle type for each condition. Paved roads means road bike. Dirt trails means mountain bike. Mixed gravel means gravel bike. City commuting means hybrid bike. Velodrome racing means track bike. Snow or sand means fat tire bike. Tricks and jumps means bmx bike. Long distance touring means touring bike. Anything else means cruiser bike. Output the list of bicycle types and include a short driver to equip several riders. Example: ["dirt trails", "city commuting", "beach boardwalk"] returns ["mountain bike", "hybrid bike", "cruiser bike"].

title: Flower Meanings
spec: Design a function `meaning(flowers)` that takes a list of flower types and returns their traditional symbolic meanings. Red rose is romantic love. Yellow rose is friendship. White lily is purity. Sunflower is adoration. Daisy is innocence. Orchid is refined beauty. Tulip is perfect love. Chrysanthemum is loyalty. For any other flower, the meaning is natural beauty. Return a list of the meanings. Include a brief test driver that interprets a mixed bouquet. Example: ["yellow rose", "daisy", "dandelion"] returns ["friendship", "innocence", "natural beauty"].

title: Sewing Stitches
spec: Implement a function `stitch(fabrics)` that receives a list of fabric handling goals and maps each to the recommended sewing machine stitch. Stretchy knits need zigzag stitch. Finishing raw edges needs overlock stitch. Hemming pants needs blind hem stitch. Quilting layers needs straight stitch. Decorative borders need scallop stitch. Joining thick leather needs saddle stitch. Gathering fabric needs basting stitch. Applique work needs buttonhole stitch. Unrecognized tasks should return standard straight stitch. Return a list of the stitch names. Add a driver section that plans a sewing project. Example: ["stretchy knits", "hemming pants", "patching"] returns ["zigzag stitch", "blind hem stitch", "standard straight stitch"].

title: Camera Lenses
spec: Create a function `lens(subjects)` that accepts a list of photography subjects and returns a list of the recommended lens focal lengths. Landscape needs wide angle fourteen millimeter. Architecture needs tilt shift twenty four millimeter. Street photography needs prime thirty five millimeter. Portrait needs prime eighty five millimeter. Sports needs telephoto two hundred millimeter. Wildlife needs super telephoto four hundred millimeter. Macro needs dedicated one hundred millimeter. Astrophotography needs ultra wide fourteen millimeter. Any other subject means standard fifty millimeter. Write a small main section to choose lenses for a photo shoot. Example: ["portrait", "sports", "family gathering"] returns ["prime eighty five millimeter", "telephoto two hundred millimeter", "standard fifty millimeter"].

title: Woodworking Joints
spec: Write a function `joint(purposes)` that processes a list of structural purposes and returns the best woodworking joint for each application. Framing a box needs butt joint. Making a drawer needs dovetail joint. Extending a board needs scarf joint. Joining tabletop panels needs edge joint. Right angle corners need miter joint. Heavy structural beams need mortise and tenon. Concealed shelving needs dado joint. Cabinet doors need rail and stile. Anything else means simple screw joint. Output the list of joint types and include a short driver for a carpentry plan. Example: ["making a drawer", "right angle corners", "attaching legs"] returns ["dovetail joint", "miter joint", "simple screw joint"].

title: Hair Type Care
spec: Design a function `care(types)` that takes a list of hair texture classifications and returns their recommended care routines. Type one straight needs daily light wash. Type two a wavy needs lightweight mousse. Type two b wavy needs sea salt spray. Type two c wavy needs hydrating gel. Type three a curly needs curl defining cream. Type three b curly needs leave in conditioner. Type three c curly needs deep moisture mask. Type four coily needs heavy butter seal. Any other classification needs general mild shampoo. Return a list of the routines. Include a brief test driver for a salon's daily clients. Example: ["type one straight", "type three a curly", "unknown"] returns ["daily light wash", "curl defining cream", "general mild shampoo"].

title: Gemstone Month Finder
spec: Implement a function `gemstone(months)` that receives a list of calendar months and maps each to its traditional birthstone. January is garnet. February is amethyst. March is aquamarine. April is diamond. May is emerald. June is pearl. July is ruby. August is peridot. September is sapphire. October is opal. November is topaz. December is turquoise. Unrecognized inputs should return synthetic crystal. Return a list of the birthstones. Add a driver section that processes a list of birthdays. Example: ["march", "october", "smarch"] returns ["aquamarine", "opal", "synthetic crystal"].

title: Soil Texture Classifier
spec: Write a function `classify(percentages)` that takes a list of three numbers representing the amounts of sand, silt, and clay. Return the phrase sand if sand is above eighty five percent. Return the phrase loamy sand if sand is between seventy and eighty five. Return the phrase sandy loam if sand is between fifty and seventy. Return the phrase loam if sand, silt, and clay are somewhat equal and clay is below twenty seven. Return the phrase silt loam if silt is above fifty and clay is below twenty seven. Return the phrase silt if silt is above eighty. Return the phrase sandy clay loam if sand is high and clay is between twenty eight and thirty five. Return the phrase clay loam if clay is between twenty eight and forty. Return the phrase silty clay loam if silt is high and clay is between twenty eight and forty. Return the phrase clay if clay is above forty. Example: an input of ten, ten, and eighty should return the phrase clay.

title: Bread Dough Hydration
spec: Write a function `evaluate(weights)` that takes a list containing flour weight and water weight. Calculate the hydration percentage. Return the phrase very stiff dough if hydration is below fifty percent. Return the phrase stiff dough if hydration is between fifty and fifty nine. Return the phrase standard dough if it is between sixty and sixty four. Return the phrase rustic dough if it is between sixty five and sixty nine. Return the phrase wet dough if it is between seventy and seventy four. Return the phrase ciabatta dough if it is between seventy five and seventy nine. Return the phrase focaccia dough if it is between eighty and eighty nine. Return the phrase batter if it is ninety or above. Example: inputting one hundred and sixty five should return the phrase rustic dough.

title: Volcano Eruption Types
spec: Write a function `determine(index)` that takes a volcanic explosivity index number. Return the phrase hawaiian if the index is zero. Return the phrase strombolian if the index is one. Return the phrase vulcanian if the index is two. Return the phrase pelean if the index is three. Return the phrase plinian if the index is four. Return the phrase paroxysmal if the index is five. Return the phrase colossal if the index is six. Return the phrase super colossal if the index is seven. Return the phrase mega colossal if the index is eight. Example: an input of four should return the phrase plinian.

title: Cloud Formation Namer
spec: Write a function `identify(attributes)` that receives a list containing an altitude number and an appearance descriptor. If altitude is above six thousand, return the phrase cirrus for wispy, cirrocumulus for patch, or cirrostratus for sheet. If altitude is between two thousand and six thousand, return the phrase altocumulus for patch, altostratus for sheet, or nimbostratus for dark. If altitude is below two thousand, return the phrase stratocumulus for patch, stratus for sheet, cumulus for puffy, or cumulonimbus for towering. Return the phrase unknown cloud if the appearance does not match. Example: inputting three thousand and patch should return the phrase altocumulus.

title: Star Spectral Class
spec: Write a function `analyze(temperature)` that accepts a surface temperature number. Return the letter o and color blue if it is over thirty thousand. Return the letter b and color blue white if it is between ten thousand and thirty thousand. Return the letter a and color white if it is between seven thousand five hundred and ten thousand. Return the letter f and color yellow white if it is between six thousand and seven thousand five hundred. Return the letter g and color yellow if it is between five thousand two hundred and six thousand. Return the letter k and color orange if it is between three thousand seven hundred and five thousand two hundred. Return the letter m and color red if it is between two thousand four hundred and three thousand seven hundred. Return the phrase brown dwarf if it is below two thousand four hundred. Return an array containing the letter and the color. Example: inputting six thousand should return an array containing g and yellow.

title: Egg Size Grader
spec: Write a function `grade(weight)` that receives an egg weight in grams. Return the phrase peewee if the weight is less than forty two. Return the phrase small if the weight is between forty two and forty nine. Return the phrase medium if the weight is between forty nine and fifty six. Return the phrase large if the weight is between fifty six and sixty three. Return the phrase extra large if the weight is between sixty three and seventy. Return the phrase jumbo if the weight is between seventy and seventy seven. Return the phrase super jumbo if the weight is between seventy seven and eighty four. Return the phrase ostrich size if the weight is eighty four or more. Example: inputting fifty should return the phrase medium.

title: Wind Beaufort Scale
spec: Write a function `assess(speed)` that takes a wind speed number. Return the phrase calm if speed is under one. Return the phrase light air if speed is between one and three. Return the phrase light breeze if speed is between four and seven. Return the phrase gentle breeze if speed is between eight and twelve. Return the phrase moderate breeze if speed is between thirteen and eighteen. Return the phrase fresh breeze if speed is between nineteen and twenty four. Return the phrase strong breeze if speed is between twenty five and thirty one. Return the phrase near gale if speed is between thirty two and thirty eight. Return the phrase gale if speed is between thirty nine and forty six. Return the phrase strong gale if speed is between forty seven and fifty four. Return the phrase storm if speed is between fifty five and sixty three. Example: inputting ten should return the phrase gentle breeze.

title: Earthquake Mercalli Intensity
spec: Write a function `measure(acceleration)` that accepts a peak ground acceleration number. Return the phrase instrumental if acceleration is below zero point zero zero one seven. Return the phrase weak if it is below zero point zero one four. Return the phrase slight if it is below zero point zero three nine. Return the phrase moderate if it is below zero point zero nine two. Return the phrase rather strong if it is below zero point eighteen. Return the phrase strong if it is below zero point thirty four. Return the phrase very strong if it is below zero point sixty five. Return the phrase severe if it is below one point twenty four. Return the phrase violent if it is below two point twenty. Return the phrase extreme if it is two point twenty or above. Example: inputting zero point five should return the phrase very strong.

title: Cheese Ripening Stages
spec: Write a function `evaluate(days)` that receives the number of days a cheese has aged. Return the phrase fresh cheese if days are less than seven. Return the phrase soft ripened if days are between seven and twenty. Return the phrase semi soft if days are between twenty one and sixty. Return the phrase medium firm if days are between sixty one and one hundred and twenty. Return the phrase firm if days are between one hundred and twenty one and two hundred and forty. Return the phrase hard cheese if days are between two hundred and forty one and four hundred. Return the phrase extra hard if days are between four hundred and one and seven hundred. Return the phrase vintage if days are over seven hundred. Example: inputting thirty should return the phrase semi soft.

title: Honey Color Scale
spec: Write a function `grade(reading)` that receives a pfund scale reading in millimeters. Return the phrase water white if the reading is below nine. Return the phrase extra white if the reading is between nine and seventeen. Return the phrase white if the reading is between seventeen and thirty four. Return the phrase extra light amber if the reading is between thirty four and fifty. Return the phrase light amber if the reading is between fifty and eighty five. Return the phrase amber if the reading is between eighty five and one hundred and fourteen. Return the phrase dark amber if the reading is between one hundred and fourteen and one hundred and forty. Return the phrase dark if the reading is over one hundred and forty. Example: inputting twenty should return the phrase white.

title: Paper Size Dimensions
spec: Write a function `name(dimensions)` that receives a list containing width and height in millimeters. Return the word zero if the dimensions are eight hundred and forty one by one thousand one hundred and eighty nine. Return the word one if dimensions are five hundred and ninety four by eight hundred and forty one. Return the word two if dimensions are four hundred twenty by five hundred ninety four. Return the word three if dimensions are two hundred ninety seven by four hundred twenty. Return the word four if dimensions are two hundred ten by two hundred ninety seven. Return the word five if dimensions are one hundred forty eight by two hundred ten. Return the word six if dimensions are one hundred five by one hundred forty eight. Return the word seven if dimensions are seventy four by one hundred five. Return the phrase custom size if there is no match. Example: inputting two hundred ten and two hundred ninety seven should return the word four.

title: Freight Train Car Types
spec: Write a function `classify(code)` that takes a single digit code for a freight car. Return the phrase boxcar for one. Return the phrase flatcar for two. Return the phrase hopper car for three. Return the phrase covered hopper for four. Return the phrase gondola for five. Return the phrase tank car for six. Return the phrase refrigerator car for seven. Return the phrase autorack for eight. Return the phrase caboose for nine. Example: inputting three should return the phrase hopper car.

title: Pearl Grading System
spec: Write a function `evaluate(attributes)` that receives a list of scores for luster, surface, and shape. Return the phrase flawless gem if all scores are ten. Return the phrase hanadama if the average is above nine. Return the phrase triple a if the average is between eight and nine. Return the phrase double a plus if the average is between seven and eight. Return the phrase double a if the average is between six and seven. Return the phrase single a plus if the average is between five and six. Return the phrase single a if the average is between four and five. Return the phrase commercial quality if the average is below four. Example: inputting eight, eight, and eight should return the phrase double a plus.

title: Hurricane Saffir Simpson Category
spec: Write a function `categorize(speed)` that receives maximum sustained wind speed. Return the phrase tropical depression if speed is below thirty nine. Return the phrase tropical storm if speed is between thirty nine and seventy three. Return the phrase category one if speed is between seventy four and ninety five. Return the phrase category two if speed is between ninety six and one hundred and ten. Return the phrase category three if speed is between one hundred and eleven and one hundred and twenty nine.
